content.value_statement: Long AI sessions can waste tokens, slow responses, and lose important context. This skill teaches compaction, masking, cache stability, and partitioning methods.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to compact conversation history near context limits.
Shows observation masking patterns for long tool outputs.
Describes prompt ordering for better KV-cache reuse.
Provides Python utility functions for token estimation and context budgeting.
Outlines partitioning strategies for sub-agent workflows.
limitations: Token estimates use rough character-based heuristics, not model tokenizers.
Example summarizers are simple heuristics and not production-grade.
Does not provide a deployed service or live monitoring integration.
Requires user judgment to preserve critical context during compression.

use_cases.title: Reduce Agent Costs
use_cases.description: Plan token budgets and compaction triggers for high-volume AI agent workloads.

use_cases.title: Stabilize Long Coding Sessions
use_cases.description: Keep important decisions and recent tool results available during extended Claude Code or Codex work.
use_cases.target_user: Developers using Claude Code or Codex

use_cases.title: Design Multi-Agent Workflows
use_cases.description: Partition large tasks across focused sub-agents while preserving useful summaries for coordination.

prompt_templates.title: Find Optimization Opportunities
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a long session or workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this conversation or agent workflow and identify where compaction, masking, cache stability, or partitioning could reduce context use. Explain the tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Token Budget
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a context budget for this agent task. Allocate space for system prompt, tools, retrieved documents, message history, tool outputs, and buffer.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Safe Compaction
prompt_templates.scenario: Compressing a long session without losing state
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a compaction plan for this long session. Preserve decisions, user preferences, current task state, recent results, and unresolved questions.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Production Strategy
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced system design for production agents
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a production context optimization strategy for this agent system. Include triggers, metrics, failure modes, and validation steps.

output_examples.input: A developer asks how to reduce token use in a long Claude Code debugging session.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends summarizing older turns, preserving current errors and decisions, and masking verbose tool output after it has served its purpose.

output_examples.input: A platform team wants lower latency for repeated agent requests.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends stable prompt prefixes, consistent formatting, delayed dynamic values, and cache hit rate monitoring.

output_examples.input: An automation architect needs to handle a document-heavy research workflow.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends partitioning work across focused sub-agents, then aggregating concise summaries into the coordinator context.

best_practices: Measure context usage before applying optimization.
Preserve task goals, user preferences, recent context, and unresolved decisions.
Test quality, latency, and cost after each optimization change.
anti_patterns: Compacting system prompts or current task requirements.
Masking recent tool outputs that are still needed for reasoning.
Adding optimization machinery before context limits cause measurable issues.

faq.question: What does this skill optimize?
faq.answer: It optimizes how agents use limited context through compaction, masking, cache-friendly prompts, and task partitioning.

faq.question: Does it increase a model context window?
faq.answer: No. It helps use the existing context window more efficiently.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance is compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Does it include runnable utilities?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes Python utilities for token estimates, observation masking, context budgets, and cache metrics.

faq.question: Is the token counting exact?
faq.answer: No. The included estimator is approximate and should be replaced with model-specific tokenizers in production.

faq.question: When should I avoid optimization?
faq.answer: Avoid it when context limits are not causing cost, latency, quality, or reliability problems.
